options.name: allowSimultaneousLogins

options.description: Details associated with billing splash.

options.name: blockAllTrafficBeforeSignOn
options.description: How restricted allowing traffic should be. If true, all traffic types are blocked until the splash page is acknowledged. If false, all non-HTTP traffic is allowed before the splash page is acknowledged.

options.name: controllerDisconnectionBehavior
options.description: How login attempts should be handled when the controller is unreachable. Can be either 'open', 'restricted', or 'default'.

options.name: guestSponsorship
options.description: Details associated with guest sponsored splash.

options.name: meraki_base_url
options.description: meraki_base_url (string), preceding all endpoint resources

options.name: meraki_be_geo_id
options.description: meraki_be_geo_id (string), optional partner identifier for API usage tracking; can also be set as an environment variable BE_GEO_ID

options.name: meraki_certificate_path

options.description: The image used in the splash page.

options.description: The logo used in the splash page.

options.description: The prepaid front image used in the splash page.

options.description: Splash timeout in minutes. This will determine how often users will see the splash page.

options.name: splashUrl
options.description: Optional The custom splash URL of the click-through splash page. Note that the URL can be configured without necessarily being used. In order to enable the custom URL, see 'useSplashUrl'.

options.name: themeId
options.description: The id of the selected splash theme.

options.name: useRedirectUrl
options.description: The Boolean indicating whether the the user will be redirected to the custom redirect URL after the splash page. A custom redirect URL must be set if this is true.

options.name: useSplashUrl
options.description: Optional Boolean indicating whether the users will be redirected to the custom splash url. A custom splash URL must be set if this is true. Note that depending on your SSID's access control settings, it may not be possible to use the custom splash URL.

options.name: welcomeMessage
options.description: The welcome message for the users on the splash page.
